Company Description

About Sia 

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We're optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Sia’s Cybersecurity & AI Trust team is the powerhouse of our firm’s innovation. With over 100 experts worldwide, we tackle projects from proof-of-concept to large-scale deployment, always pushing the boundaries of AI capabilities. By joining Sia’s Cybersecurity team, you’ll step into a vibrant, collaborative environment that nurtures professional growth and empowers you to shape the future of consulting.

Job Description

As a Managing Director within Sia’s Cybersecurity & AI Trust Business Line, this role is responsible for driving the growth and market positioning of the firm through business development, account management, and deep cybersecurity expertise across areas such as cyber strategy, security transformation, and risk and compliance. Responsibilities include the development of strategic client relationships and large-scale engagements across key markets and industries, as well as leading and growing a team of consultants and contributing to the firm's cybersecurity thought leadership and offering development. This position requires a strong external presence, an established senior executive network, and a proven track record of originating and closing new businesses, alongside the ability to lead complex engagements and convert deep technical expertise into sustained commercial impact.

Key Responsibilities

Lead complex cybersecurity engagements from strategy through execution, serving as the senior executive accountable for delivery and client impact.
Provide executive-level guidance on cybersecurity governance, cyber resilience, and cyber transformation to Boards and C-suite leaders.
Lead delivery excellence by ensuring technical rigor, quality assurance, and consistency across engagements while driving optimized staffing and efficient delivery management.

Business Development:   

Drive substantial revenue growth by originating new business through proactive client acquisition, expanding existing relationships, and managing strategic accounts.
Drive the hub’s cybersecurity business expansion by leading go-to-market strategy, commercial prospecting, pre-sales engagement, client sales discussions, and development of tailored solution offerings.
Champion cross-Business Line collaboration by identifying and facilitating opportunities to bring complementary Sia expertise (e.g., Risk, Data, Strategy) into client engagements, maximizing the firm's overall value proposition.

People Leadership and Team Development

Provide, oversight, and mentorship to project teams, ensuring high-quality delivery and alignment with client objectives. 
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning across engagements and internal initiatives.  
Attract, develop and retain top talent by actively coaching team members, supporting professional growth, and contributing to performance management.  
Implement the Business Line strategy and actively promote the firm’s mission, vision, culture and purpose
Participate in the major cybersecurity trade shows attended by C-Level executives
Drive the achievement of relevant cybersecurity clearances

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

Shape a differentiated point of view on industry trends, emerging technologies, and enterprise transformation, and represent Sia as a recognized voice through conferences, panels, and executive forums. 
Build market credibility through advisory roles, council memberships, and active leadership in professional organizations. 

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be added, deleted, or modified at any time based on business needs.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or information security.
7+ years in a senior leadership role within a consulting firm
Experience leading large-scale enterprise cybersecurity transformations.
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or cloud security certifications are strongly preferred.

Additional information

Compensation & Benefits 

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow. 

Compensation 

Base Salary: $200,000–$280,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.
Personal Sales Bonus (uncapped) 
Annual Performance Bonus (appraisal)

Benefits 

Medical, dental, and vision coverage 
Company-paid life and AD&D insurance; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP at no cost 
401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA
College savings and student loan repayment programs 
Paid parental leave 
Generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday 
Monthly cell phone stipend 
Well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements. 

Workplace 

Sia embraces a flexible workplace model that balances autonomy with in-person connection. Management is expected to be in the office at least three days per week, serving as culture carriers who mentor teams, strengthen client relationships, and lead by example. 

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Commitment

At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, IT Services
jobs.description:
What You Will Do

GFT
is seeking a Senior Project Manager
to join our Practice or IT Services team! This role follows a remote work model, however you must be located in the United States and preferably in the Central time zone.

What You’ll Be Challenged To Do

The Senior Project Manager, IT Services is responsible for leading complex, cross functional technology initiatives from planning through delivery. This role bridges business objectives and technical execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business value. The Senior Project Manager provides strong leadership, governance, and risk management while coordinating across engineering, architecture, data, security, and business stakeholders.

In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

Leads end-to-end delivery of complex technical projects, including enterprise systems, integrations, cloud platforms, and data initiatives
Defines project scope, objectives, success criteria, and delivery approach in alignment with business and technical stakeholders
Develops and manages project plans, schedules, dependencies, budgets, resource allocations, and project performance against key milestones.
Serves as the primary point of accountability for project execution, issue resolution, and decision escalation
Coordinates cross-functional teams, including developers, architects, data engineers, vendors, business partners, and third-party providers.
Translates business requirements into actionable technical work plans and ensure alignment with architectural standards
Establishes and maintains project governance, status reporting, and executive level communication
Identify, assess, and actively manage project risks, assumptions, dependencies, and change requests, with mitigation plans and impact assessments in place.
Facilitates key project ceremonies such as kickoff meetings, design reviews, status reviews, and retrospectives
Ensures quality delivery through adherence to best practices, documentation standards, and technical validation
Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Education | Experience:

What You Will Bring To Our Firm

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
15+ years of project management experience delivering complex technology and business transformation initiatives.
Proven experience managing large, cross-functional projects involving enterprise applications, cloud platforms, integrations, infrastructure, data, and security teams.
Demonstrated success managing projects through the full project lifecycle, from initiation and planning through implementation and post-production support.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches.
Experience developing and managing project plans, budgets, schedules, dependencies, and resource allocations.
Proven ability to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Experience leading vendor and third-party implementation partners and managing contractual deliverables.
Experience facilitating governance processes, steering committees, status reviews, and executive reporting.
Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into actionable technical delivery plans.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.

What We Prefer You Bring

Master’s degree in business administration (MBA), Information Systems, Technology Management, or a related discipline.
Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI-ACP, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or equivalent project management certification.
Experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation, cloud migration, ERP, CRM, HRIS, analytics, or data modernization initiatives.
Experience within Architecture, Engineering, Construction (AEC), professional services, or other project-driven industries.
Knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, application integration methodologies, and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
Experience managing large portfolios, programs, or multiple concurrent strategic initiatives.
Familiarity with organizational change management frameworks and adoption strategies.
Experience overseeing distributed or geographically dispersed project teams.
Experience mentoring project managers, business analysts, or project coordinators.
Knowledge of governance, compliance, cybersecurity, and risk management practices within enterprise environments.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $150,000. Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location.

Featured Benefits

Hybrid (in-person and remote) work environment.
Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.
Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan.
Competitive paid-time-off (PTO) accrual.
Tuition reimbursement for continued education.
Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations
Incentive compensation for eligible positions.

Company Overview

At GFT, a privately held AEC firm, we innovate where transportation, water, power, and buildings converge. We call this the Infrastructure of Life. We measure our success by the strength of our relationships – that’s why we’re the employer of choice for 5,000+ of the industry’s brightest engineers, planners, architects, inspectors, designers, and more.

Our clients choose us for our expertise and prefer us for our nimble approach, creativity, and personal touch. Backed by over a century’s experience, together we’re building a lasting legacy for future generations: stronger communities, a healthier planet, and better lives.

GFT: Ingenuity That Shapes Lives™
is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veterans’ status or other characteristics protected by law.

Unsolicited resumes from third party agencies will be considered the property GFT.

GFT does require the successful completion of a criminal background check for all advertised positions.

Location:
United States, remote

Core Business Hours:
8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Employment Status:
Full-Time

Application Deadline Date:
10/24/26

Applicants in the County of Los Angeles-
Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Applicants in the City of San Francisco-
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Applicants in the State of California
-Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.
